title: rumohra globisora
intro: Rumohra globisora, commonly known as the Himalayan Holly Fern, is a type of evergreen fern native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, helping to protect against cell damage and infections. The therapeutic actions of Rumohra globisora include being used as an anti-arthritic agent, an anti-diabetic agent, and an antispasmodic agent, making it beneficial for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
